_meta.command: docker run --rm --entrypoint python <sidecar-image> -c "from faster_whisper.tokenizer import _LANGUAGE_CODES; import json; print(json.dumps(sorted(_LANGUAGE_CODES)))"
_meta.note: The set of language codes the Whisper tokenizer has tokens for. This is a fact about the model rather than a probe result, and it is *stronger* evidence than an HTTP 200: a code outside this list cannot be conditioned on at all, while a code inside it is guaranteed to be accepted. It says nothing whatsoever about output quality, which is the whole point of the project and is Phase 5's work. `yue` is present alongside `zh` in large-v3.
